outlet.name: ABC News (US)
outlet.summary: ABC News is leading with the death of Dolly Parton and the Nepal flood disaster, alongside Ukraine drone attacks on Moscow, the Pakistan hospital fire and Darline Graham's GOP primary win.

items.headline: Country music legend Dolly Parton dies at 80 after a brief battle with cancer
items.detail: The iconic singer-songwriter died surrounded by loved ones, her representatives said, prompting tributes from Taylor Swift, Beyonce and others.

items.headline: Americans reported among hundreds missing in Nepal floods
items.detail: At least three American tourists were reported among a preliminary toll of hundreds missing after flash floods swept through Nepal.

items.headline: Moscow airports disrupted amid Ukraine drone attacks following the CIA director's visit
items.detail: Ukrainian drone attacks resumed on Moscow hours after CIA Director John Ratcliffe's visit, disrupting airports in the Russian capital.

items.headline: 14 newborns killed in a fire at a Pakistan hospital
items.detail: A doctor said 14 newborns were killed in a fire at a hospital in Pakistan, one of several deadly blazes reported this week.

items.headline: Darline Graham wins the GOP runoff to replace her brother on the South Carolina ballot
items.detail: The Trump-backed candidate, whose brother Lindsey Graham died in July, won the runoff to contest the Senate seat, according to the AP.
